59 tests with 257 expectations pass, including bounded workspace-state validation, backward-compatible settings defaults and custom history-policy validation.
Main, preload and renderer bundles compile with workspace-state load/save IPC, tab restoration and configurable retention controls.

implemented: Added validated WorkspaceState IPC persisted in Electron user data with a vault-root guard, bounded relative tabs/navigation and active-tab repair.
Restored saved tabs after selecting the matching vault, kept missing notes recoverable, and persisted the repaired state without changing authoritative vault bytes.
Made recovery-history age and byte-cap policy user-configurable in the non-modal settings surface and used the saved policy for review and explicit cleanup planning.
limitations: The Electron binary is unavailable locally, so visible launch, restart/readback, accessibility-tree and cross-platform UI automation were not completed.
The state contract, renderer wiring and compile path are tested, but a process-level restart fixture and visible on-device state restoration remain pending.
Full Markdown dialect rendering, command-palette coverage, live external sync, reference Obsidian reopen checks and long-running retention checks remain pending.
